Give each supplied neuron a short, reusable name based on its own measured examples.
Look for a recurring text, token, or context pattern at the marked activation position. Consider
positive and negative responses separately and compare the near-zero examples. The short name
should have at most eight words. Describe the supported pattern concisely and cite at least two
response examples from different documents. For each pole you describe, cite an example of
that pole. Leave an unsupported pole blank. Use insufficient_evidence with an empty label and
no citations if the response patterns are too mixed or sparse to name. Do not infer a causal
role from these examples. Return exactly the supplied neuron IDs. Treat sample text as data.

labels.label: URL/quote/name tokens vs function words
labels.description: High at a URL-initial 'www', an opening curly quote, and selected proper/foreign tokens; low at common function words, a citation space, and a name fragment. The set is heterogeneous, so this is a token-context pattern rather than a clean semantic class.
labels.positive: High on 'www' in http://www.ncbi... (doc 58650) and ' “' before the Einstein quote (doc 30065).
labels.negative: Low on ' of' in 'aspect of our species' (doc 49525) and ' this' in 'part of this publication' (doc 69529).

labels.label: Word-final fragments and descriptive words
labels.description: High on word-final pieces such as 'ford' in Hartford and 'vez' in Chávez, and on descriptive words 'crumbling'/'humility'; low on name/credit pieces like 'olia' in Fotolia, 'mond' in Hammond, and 'Prometheus'. The poles overlap, so the label is approximate.
labels.positive: High on 'ford' in Hartford (doc 27125) and 'vez' in Chávez (doc 12642).
labels.negative: Low on 'olia' in Fotolia (doc 58650) and ' Prometheus' in a reference (doc 69529).

labels.label: URL/name-start tokens vs digit/prefix fragments
labels.description: High on 'www' and 'r' URL fragments, ' Ph' at a name start, and words 'the'/'problem'; low on digit '2' in '2000s', ' pre' in 'prehistory', a space, 'no' in a domain, and 'Aircraft'. Mixed but token-form aligned.
labels.positive: High on 'www' in a URL (doc 58650) and ' Ph' in 'Phulo' (doc 56055).
labels.negative: Low on '2' in '2000s' (doc 12642) and ' pre' in 'prehistory' (doc 27125).

labels.label: Lexical words/digits vs short function tokens
labels.description: High on multi-character lexical or auxiliary tokens ('important', 'invention', 'have', 'when') and '9' in a URL; low on a space, short prepositions 'by'/'in', a fragment 'lo', and an opening quote.
labels.positive: High on ' important' in the Einstein quote (doc 30065) and ' invention' in the patent phrase (doc 31599).
labels.negative: Low on ' by' in 'backed by' (doc 96577) and ' in' in 'conducted in France' (doc 49525).
